notes.title: Survive in Angaria : Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

A new update is available!

[list]
[*]Now you can play with your controller!
[*]We fixed campfire!
[*]We fixed launch errors!
[/list]

And you can play our new game Paul's World on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160880/Pauls_World/

Time to work more!
Love,
Cloaz Studio!

[list]
